articles.title: Americans traded $571 million on Polymarket politic bets despite U.S. ban
articles.snippet: U.S.-linked wallets traded $571 million in political contracts over the past year, more than any other country, even though the platform legally cannot serve them. The money leans toward the foreign-conflict markets U.S. venues do not list.

articles.title: Moonbeam to pivot from Polkadot to Base, unveils AI agent framework
articles.snippet: Moonbeam didn’t provide a timeline for when it would launch the AI agent platform but told GLMR holders to bridge their tokens from the Polkadot parachain to Base before July 31.

articles.title: Crypto Biz: Bitcoin maximalism meets the realities of capital markets
articles.snippet: Strategy authorizes Bitcoin sales, Open USD takes on USDT and USDC, Fidelity defends Bitcoin security and crypto ramps up political spending for 2026.

articles.title: Belgian police arrest suspected phishing gang leader tied to $572K theft
articles.snippet: Belgian authorities say a European phishing gang stole over $572,000 from victims before laundering the proceeds through cryptocurrency.

articles.title: Farage Reported to UK Standards Watchdog Over Alleged Crypto Lobbying
articles.snippet: A Labour MP says the Reform leader pressed the Bank of England on policy that could enrich his biggest donor, a major Tether investor.
